{"body":"### Evaluator integration at `1b29b7f9`

Integrated #267 at `66952415` through a normal merge. Local consumer controls **13/13**, diagnostics **11/11**, verdict **8/8** and runner **8/8 PASS**; 32 valid reports preserved except additive sampling status, 16 retained STAR replays emit reports, and all 185 archive files are hash-verified. See `docs/post_rc0/s1/km_truth/integration_20261022/README.md`. Independent source review found no material issue; [Integration-head Linux CI](https://github.com/KingAlejandro/MotionCorr-standalone/actions/runs/39773436033) **PASS**: CPU build/checks and CUDA compile-only. No native execution or scientific qualification is inferred. The historical 900-arm campaign retains its original source identity and is not requalified; native, scientific and performance qualification remain UNRUN.

---

Conditioning both global and local CCF DC bins improves high-pedestal accuracy against motion truth: median per-seed field RMS 1.78785→0.29919 px on CPU and 1.73835→0.29918 px on CUDA; 10/10 paired wins each, exact sign p=0.001953125. Both float backends approach the double-CCF reference within 0.000154 px on all 100 movies. Remaining field-limit failures are retained; this is not scientific/release qualification.

Test-only extension of #267, targeting `test/known-motion-diagnostics-v2`: 100 movies (ten conditions × ten independent Poisson seeds), 4096² / 5760×4092, 40 frames, dose/pedestal/amplitude sweeps, polynomial and out-of-model motion. Independent oversampled synthesis with inverse/sign/orientation mutants; native pre-write model capture; global/local/total/border/time errors in px/Å; paired seed tests and separate CPU/CUDA/reference distances. All 900 Release native arms exit 0, with source/binary/UUID/input/argv/exit provenance. Movies and native products remain on task hosts; committed evidence contains receipts, hashes and diagnostic records.

Other both-stage conditions are neutral/mixed except a nominal CPU amplitude×0.25 gain (p=0.02148). CUDA global-only has a tiny nominal out-of-model harm (+0.00002664 px, p=0.02148), retained explicitly. Native #267 controls: only zero passes the existing field gate; noisy/unidentifiable/checker-ROI failures remain visible and the adapter issue was commented on #267. Frequency transfer, held-out science and controlled performance are unrun. Shared CPU bugs remain FILE-ONLY; no production repair or merge.

Validation: 10 new infrastructure tests and 24 existing diagnostic/verdict/runner controls pass; code-head `4916ec04` Linux CI passes. Native MRC/correct-row TIFF trajectories agree exactly; the wrong-row mutant fails.
